tools.name: list_alert_history
tools.description: Today's Discord-posted A+/B (same gates as #alerts-a / #alerts-b). Newest first.

tools.name: get_rails
tools.description: Live SPY 0DTE gamma map: walls, flip, magnet, regime.

tools.name: get_tape
tools.description: Live Confluence Tape: coded flow, OFI, quadrant.

tools.name: get_morning_desk
tools.description: Today's Tier-0 morning desk card (rails, IV rank, gap, events).

tools.name: get_market_clock
tools.description: Session state: open/closed, force-flat time, lane windows.

tools.name: get_skew
tools.description: IV smile / skew strip + wing-fattening flag from Tradier chain.

tools.name: get_pin
tools.description: Pin score / magnet heuristic for the symbol.

tools.name: get_gex_profile
tools.description: Per-strike GEX profile near spot.

tools.name: get_em
tools.description: 1σ expected-move band from ATM IV (remaining session).

tools.name: get_rv_regime
tools.description: HAR-lite RV: Calm / Elevated / Explosive (not Trapdoor wall trust).

tools.name: get_spy_qqq_divergence
tools.description: SPY↔QQQ rails divergence feather.

tools.name: get_replay_today
tools.description: Today's graded candidates timeline (educational replay).

tools.name: get_hist_replay
tools.description: Multi-day historical graded events from scanner log (optional YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: check_alert_tradeable
tools.description:
Pro Tier-1 gate: score >= 6/8, inside 9:45–3:45 PM ET window, level present.
        Pass alert_json to check a specific record; else uses latest alert.

tools.name: plan_robinhood_entry
tools.description:
Build Robinhood execution plan from alert: delta band, spread gate, budget, bracket, MCP steps.
        Advisory only — does not place orders.

tools.name: format_bracket_plan
tools.description: Scale/stop premium levels from fill price E (+25% target, -25% cap).

tools.name: pro_rules_summary
tools.description: Pro alert criteria: min score and session window.

tools.name: get_premium_compression_data
tools.description:
Premium Compression Heatmap: theta decay velocity by session window for a multi-leg structure.
        Pro tier. structure: "iron_condor" | "vertical_spread_call" | "vertical_spread_put" | "single" | "short_call" | "short_put"

tools.name: get_path_risk_score
tools.description: Path-Risk Meter: dynamic execution risk score from spread + tick variance. Pro tier.

tools.name: get_cvd_liquidity
tools.description:
Real-Time CVD Liquidity Tracker: aggregate Net CVD using Lee-Ready on minute bars.
        Pro tier. interval: "1m" | "5m"

tools.name: get_vrp_divergence
tools.description: VRP Divergence Index: ATM straddle IV vs realized variance. Bundle tier.

tools.name: get_index_health
tools.description:
Index Health Dashboard: relative volume & momentum for top components.
        Bundle tier. index: "SPY" | "QQQ"

tools.name: get_macro_events
tools.description: Macro Event Control Panel: high-impact economic events with vol forecasts. Bundle tier.

tools.name: get_daily_structure
tools.description: Daily Structure Board: automated pivots, ATR targets, overnight boundaries. Bundle tier.

tools.name: get_swing_structure
tools.description: Weekly/swing gamma walls + 1σ EM on the nearest 5–45 DTE expiry (not 0DTE). Bundle/Pro.

tools.name: get_lotto_friday
tools.description: Advisory single-name 0DTE Friday board with liquidity gates. Not auto-exec.

tools.name: get_correlation_grid
tools.description: Rolling 5-min return correlation for SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA. Portfolio overlay, not a trigger.

tools.name: get_cross_asset
tools.description: Tradier VIX, 10Y (TNX), dollar (UUP). Risk-tone overlay — not a trigger.

tools.name: get_major_news
tools.description: MAJOR RSS headlines. Context only — never a trigger.

tools.name: get_yield_curve
tools.description: Delayed official FRED 10Y / 2Y / 2s10s.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Intraday fear/greed composite (Tape + VIX). Fade extremes at a rail.
